fact: The Council of Ministers approved a draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, which includes a national digital identification system linked to the biometric national ID card; the bill moves to the next legislative stage.

source_slug: 2025-11-05 Algeria approves draft law on national digital ID and trust services

fact: The Algerian government approved on 2 November 2025 a draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, which introduces a national digital identification framework based on the existing biometric identity card and updates the 2015 e-signature law.
system: Draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification

fact: Loi n° 26-02 of 17 February 2026 fixes the general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and on electronic identification; it is a law, published by the ministry of post and telecommunications.
By its title Loi n° 26-02 of 17 February 2026 sets the rules for electronic identification, and the stories on its draft say it introduces a national digital identity.
